macros.v11:metricsv:app: Against B, \sys{} gains on the second recogniser by +1.32$^{*}$ / +3.74$^{*}$ / +0.93$^{*}$ and in speech COMET by +2.58$^{*}$ / +0.34$^{*}$ / +1.47$^{*}$ (AMI Zh$\rightarrow$En / En$\rightarrow$Zh / AliMeeting); text COMET is unchanged by construction. The En$\rightarrow$Zh second-recogniser gain is much larger than with Paraformer because Whisper fails more often on B's audio (repetition loops or hallucinated phrases in 16\% of B's utterances against 6\% of \sys{}'s; +6.46 before removing them), so only its sign is informative. \sys{}+WA differs from \sys{} on neither metric significantly.
